title: Eight Banks, Five Months: The New CFO Rulebook
subtitle: RBI Commercial Banks – Governance Directions, 2025 turned a CA-plus-fifteen-years profile into the liquid ticket for a private-bank CFO chair. A composite NRC at Sutlej Bank must choose tonight.
description: HBS-style teaching case dated 7 September 2026. Publicly reported facts: BW People (Savi Khanna, 5 Sep 2026) recorded at least eight systemically important Indian banks changing a senior finance or governance officer in about five months of mid-2026, including Puneet Sharma (Axis to HDFC Bank), Rajeev Mantri (Bandhan to Axis) and Bhavin Lakhpatwala (HDFC Bank to RBL), plus CFO changes at Equitas SFB, Bank of India and IndusInd. Structural driver: RBI (Commercial Banks – Governance) Directions, 2025 (28 Nov 2025; RBI/DOR/2025-26/149) Paragraph 36 — qualified CA; 15 years overseeing financial operations, of which 10 in banks/FIs, of which 5 at senior management — now applied mutatis mutandis to private banks. Composite firm: Sutlej Bank. Composite candidates: Meera Iyer and Arjun Deshmukh.
thumbnail: EIGHT BANKS. ONE RULE. WHO SITS?
